patch.value: Train a history-prefix learner on the public tracker environment

PR 84 acceptance scored 107/214 on meta-validation versus the completed-majority baseline 211/214, and 198/385 on final-test versus 384/385. All candidates retained the zero-weight seed checkpoint because inner fits were refused. Add a bounded learner that actually reads the normalized history prefix, such as the existing LM adapter, on the sealed repository-split tracker environment.

Train only on training repositories; preserve inner-held-out, meta-validation and final-test boundaries, fixed pre-approved budgets and unchanged promotion gate; report majority baselines, prediction diversity and final-test scores; demonstrate statistically supported improvement or explicitly report a null result without weakening the gate.
